project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Python FastAPI backend, React Vite frontend, Cloudflare Workers edge layer, Azure infra (Bicep)
build_system: pnpm 10.26.1 workspaces with pip-compile for Python. Root package.json has 'packageManager' field.
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile from root. 2. Type-check edge: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit. 3. Type-check frontend: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit. 4. Validate all workflow YAML with python yaml.safe_load. 5. Check actionlint-equivalent schema validation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml is checked in. Regenerate with: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
setup_instructions: Node 22+ and pnpm 10.26.1 are pre-installed. Run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Python 3.11, Node 22, pnpm 10.26.1 available.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Conventions: conventional commits, pnpm workspaces, TypeScript strict mode.
key_patterns: Workflows use: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/setup-python@v5, azure/login@v3 (node24), cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3. Corepack used for pnpm activation. The 'if:' conditions in some workflows use bare numeric comparisons on string step outputs.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, pnpm-lock.yaml. apps/backend/ (Python FastAPI), apps/frontend/ (React Vite), apps/edge/ (Cloudflare Worker). .github/workflows/ (24 workflow files), .github/scripts/ (4 support files). infra/ (Bicep templates).
